scripts.db:reset: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U retail -d retail_sonnet -f /dev/stdin < database/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U retail -d retail_sonnet -f /dev/stdin < database/seed.sql
scripts.db:test:reset: (docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U retail -d retail -tc "select 1 from pg_database where datname='retail_test_sonnet'" | grep -q 1 || docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U retail -d retail -c "create database retail_test_sonnet") && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U retail -d retail_test_sonnet -f /dev/stdin < database/schema.sql
